source.name: CF Montréal – 'CF Montréal unveils new primary jersey'
source.quote: BMO Financial Group, CF Montréal's main partner, is once again featured prominently in the centre of the jersey for a 14th consecutive MLS season.

note: The club's 2025 kit announcement calls 2025 BMO's 14th consecutive MLS season in the centre of the jersey, so the front-of-shirt deal reaches back to Montréal's inaugural MLS season, 2012. No deal value reported.
